info.name: Lending Nelson API
info.description: Complete backend regression collection generated from FastAPI commit 0a04f3a.

exec: pm.test('Borrower list contains controlled borrower', () => pm.expect(json.some(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('borrowerId'))).to.be.true);
const add = days => { const d = new Date(now); d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + days); return iso(d); };

pm.test('Active loan contract is valid', () => { pm.expect(json.borrowerId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('borrowerId')); pm.expect(json.requestId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('loanRequestId')); pm.expect(json.status).to.eql('Active'); pm.expect(validDecimal(json.originalPrincipal)).to.be.true; pm.expect(json.installments).to.be.an('array').and.not.empty; });

pm.test('Approve response is valid', () => { pm.expect(json.loanId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('draftLoanId')); pm.expect(json.action).to.eql('approve'); pm.expect(json.status).to.eql('Draft'); pm.expect(json.occurredAt).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('Seed provides a paid loan', () => pm.expect(json.length).to.be.above(0));
pm.test('Paid loan is closed', () => { pm.expect(json.action).to.eql('close'); pm.expect(json.status).to.eql('Paid'); pm.expect(json.occurredAt).to.exist; });
pm.test('Legacy response remains an array', () => pm.expect(json).to.be.an('array'));
const paid = json.find(x => x.status === 'Paid'); if (paid) pm.collectionVariables.set('paidLoanId', paid.id);

pm.test('Pagination metadata is valid', () => { pm.expect(json.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(json.total).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(json.offset).to.eql(0); pm.expect(json.limit).to.eql(10); pm.expect(json.items.length).to.be.at.most(10); });
pm.test('Loan page ordering is stable', () => { for (let i=1;i<json.items.length;i++) pm.expect(json.items[i-1].createdAt >= json.items[i].createdAt).to.be.true; });
pm.test('Borrower filter is respected', () => pm.expect(json.items.every(x => x.borrowerId === pm.collectionVariables.get('borrowerId'))).to.be.true);
pm.test('Status filter is respected', () => pm.expect(json.items.every(x => x.status === 'Paid')).to.be.true);

pm.test('Preview allocation is decimal-safe', () => ['paymentAmount','appliedInterest','appliedPrincipal','unappliedCredit','principalAfter'].forEach(k => pm.expect(validDecimal(json[k]), k).to.be.true));
pm.test('Payment appears in ledger', () => pm.expect(json.some(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentId'))).to.be.true);

pm.test('Payment pagination is valid', () => { pm.expect(json.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(json.total).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(json.offset).to.eql(0); pm.expect(json.limit).to.eql(10); pm.expect(json.items.some(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentId'))).to.be.true; });

pm.test('Receipt belongs to captured payment', () => { pm.expect(json.receiptNumber).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(json.paymentId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentId')); pm.expect(json.requestId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentRequestId')); pm.expect(json.borrower).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(json.loan).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(json.recordedBy).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(json.reversalStatus).to.eql('Original'); });

pm.test('Statement contains payment and reconciles', () => { pm.expect(json.paymentHistory.some(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentId'))).to.be.true; pm.expect(json.reconciliation.reconciled).to.be.true; pm.expect(json.runningBalance.every(x => Number(x.runningBalance) >= 0)).to.be.true; });

pm.test('Dashboard counts and money are valid', () => { ['totalBorrowers','activeLoans','paidLoans','overdueLoans','defaultedLoans','dueTodayCount'].forEach(k => { pm.expect(json[k]).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(json[k]).to.be.at.least(0); }); ['outstandingBalance','dueToday','cashCollectedToday','collectionProgress'].forEach(k => pm.expect(validDecimal(json[k]), k).to.be.true); pm.expect(Number(json.collectionProgress)).to.be.within(0,100); });

pm.test('Financial report metrics are valid', () => { ['outstandingPortfolio','collections','interestEarned','principalCollected','unappliedCredits','overdueAmount','portfolioAtRisk'].forEach(k => pm.expect(validDecimal(json[k]), k).to.be.true); pm.expect(json.loanAging).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(json.collectorPerformance).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('Duplicate request id syncs without duplication', () => pm.expect(json.syncedTransactionUuids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('syncTransactionId')));

pm.test('Successful item survives later failure', () => { pm.expect(json.syncedTransactionUuids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('syncSuccessTransactionId')); pm.expect(json.failures.some(x => x.transactionUuid === pm.collectionVariables.get('syncFailureTransactionId'))).to.be.true; });

pm.test('Reversal references original payment', () => { pm.expect(json.entryType).to.eql('Reversal'); pm.expect(json.reversalOfPaymentId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentId')); pm.expect(json.note).to.eql('Postman reversal verification'); });

item.name: Reject New Reversal For Reversed Payment

exec: pm.test('Statement retains payment and reversal', () => { pm.expect(json.paymentHistory.some(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('paymentId'))).to.be.true; pm.expect(json.reversalHistory.some(x => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('reversalId'))).to.be.true; pm.expect(json.reconciliation.reconciled).to.be.true; });
